title: Pure-tensor normalization of the affine degree comparison homomorphism
statement: For a morphism f from the lifted Amitsur degree-n term to the singleton tensor-section Čech degree-n term, the normalization predicate asserts that evaluation at the unique outer product index sends each lifted m tensor tprod(b) to the product of the pulled-back b(k) acting on the étale tensor restriction of m. This is the existing comparison-isomorphism predicate applied only to the homomorphism, without invertibility.

lean.statement:
def IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n) : Prop
